title: 出行与服务精选 · 106 句
description: 机场、酒店、餐饮、公共交通、租车、购物、问路、户外活动与求助；按具体沟通任务编写，并附逐题用法。

items.zh: 我的行李还没到，但传送带已经停了。
items.en: My suitcase hasn't arrived, but the baggage carousel has stopped.
answers: My suitcase hasn't arrived, but the baggage carousel has stopped.
My suitcase has not arrived, but the baggage carousel has stopped.
items.notes: 两处现在完成时对照当前状况；baggage carousel 指行李转盘。

items.zh: 如果第一班航班晚点，航空公司会帮我安排后续转机吗？
items.en: If my first flight is delayed, will the airline help me rebook the connection?
answers: If my first flight is delayed, will the airline help me rebook the connection?
items.notes: 条件从句使用被动语态；connection 在此指转机航班。

items.zh: 这件随身行李需要托运，还是可以带进客舱？
items.en: Does this carry-on bag need to be checked in, or can I take it into the cabin?
answers: Does this carry-on bag need to be checked in, or can I take it into the cabin?
items.notes: need to be done 表示需要被处理；check in 在此指托运行李。

items.zh: 我收到登机口变更通知后，又核对了一次出发屏幕。
items.en: After receiving a gate-change notification, I checked the departure board again.
answers: After receiving a gate-change notification, I checked the departure board again.
items.notes: after doing 的逻辑主语为 I；departure board 指出发信息屏。

items.zh: 虽然我的机票上没有座位号，但预订已经确认了。
items.en: Although my ticket has no seat number, the booking has been confirmed.
answers: Although my ticket has no seat number, the booking has been confirmed.
items.notes: although 引出表面矛盾；has been confirmed 是现在完成时被动。

items.zh: 您能帮我找一个靠近登机口的洗手间吗？
items.en: Could you help me find a toilet near the boarding gate?
answers: Could you help me find a toilet near the boarding gate?
items.notes: help sb do；near 引出位置，不需要额外加 to。

items.zh: 我预订的房间应该可以看到海，但这间朝向停车场。
items.en: The room I booked was supposed to have a sea view, but this one faces the car park.
answers: The room I booked was supposed to have a sea view, but this one faces the car park.
items.notes: be supposed to have 表示按原先约定应当有；faces 表示朝向。

items.zh: 我们能把行李寄存在这里，下午再回来取吗？
items.en: Can we leave our bags here and collect them this afternoon?
answers: Can we leave our bags here and collect them this afternoon?
items.notes: leave ... here 表示留在这里；collect 在此指取回。

items.zh: 如果延迟退房需要收费，请先告诉我金额。
items.en: If there is a charge for late checkout, please tell me the amount first.
answers: If there is a charge for late checkout, please tell me the amount first.
items.notes: there is 表示存在；charge for 指针对某项服务的收费。

items.zh: 空调每隔几分钟就会发出很大的声音，让我难以入睡。
items.en: The air conditioner makes a loud noise every few minutes, which makes it difficult for me to sleep.
answers: The air conditioner makes a loud noise every few minutes, which makes it difficult for me to sleep.
items.notes: every few minutes 表示每隔几分钟；which 引出整件事造成的影响。

items.zh: 与其换到另一层，我们更希望住在同一层相邻的两间房。
items.en: Rather than move to another floor, we'd prefer two rooms next to each other on the same floor.
answers: Rather than move to another floor, we'd prefer two rooms next to each other on the same floor.
items.notes: would prefer + 名词表示更想要；next to each other 表示彼此相邻。

items.zh: 您可以安排明早六点半的叫醒服务吗？
items.en: Could you arrange a wake-up call for half past six tomorrow morning?
answers: Could you arrange a wake-up call for half past six tomorrow morning?
items.notes: arrange ... for + 时间；half past six 表示六点半。

items.zh: 我对花生过敏，这道菜里含花生或花生油吗？
items.en: I'm allergic to peanuts; does this dish contain peanuts or peanut oil?
answers: I'm allergic to peanuts; does this dish contain peanuts or peanut oil?
I am allergic to peanuts; does this dish contain peanuts or peanut oil?
items.notes: be allergic to 表示对某物过敏；用具体成分确认，不能仅凭菜名判断。

items.zh: 我们能分开付款，还是必须一起结账？
items.en: Can we pay separately, or do we have to settle the bill together?
answers: Can we pay separately, or do we have to settle the bill together?
items.notes: settle the bill 表示结账；separately 与 together 构成选择。

items.zh: 这不是我点的菜，我点的是烤鱼。
items.en: This isn't what I ordered; I ordered the grilled fish.
answers: This isn't what I ordered; I ordered the grilled fish.
This is not what I ordered; I ordered the grilled fish.
items.notes: what I ordered 为名词性从句；grilled 表示烤制的。

items.zh: 如果厨房已经关了，附近还有哪里可以买到食物？
items.en: If the kitchen has closed, where nearby can I get something to eat?
answers: If the kitchen has closed, where nearby can I get something to eat?
items.notes: if + 现在完成时说明当前条件；something to eat 指可吃的东西。

items.zh: 虽然我们没有预订，但愿意等一张靠窗的桌子。
items.en: Although we don't have a reservation, we're happy to wait for a table by the window.
answers: Although we don't have a reservation, we're happy to wait for a table by the window.
Although we do not have a reservation, we are happy to wait for a table by the window.
items.notes: be happy to do 在此表示愿意；by the window 表示在窗边。

items.zh: 能否把酱汁单独放，让我自己决定加多少？
items.en: Could you serve the sauce on the side so that I can decide how much to add?
answers: Could you serve the sauce on the side so that I can decide how much to add?
items.notes: on the side 表示酱汁另外放；so that 说明请求目的。

items.zh: 这张票允许我在一小时内换乘公交车吗？
items.en: Does this ticket allow me to transfer to a bus within an hour?
answers: Does this ticket allow me to transfer to a bus within an hour?
items.notes: allow sb to do；within an hour 表示在一小时以内。

items.zh: 下一站到了时，能提醒我一下吗？
items.en: Could you let me know when we reach the next stop?
answers: Could you let me know when we reach the next stop?
items.notes: let sb know 表示告知；when 引出到站的时间。

items.zh: 由于线路施工，列车今天不在这个站停靠。
items.en: Because of engineering works, trains aren't stopping at this station today.
answers: Because of engineering works, trains aren't stopping at this station today.
Because of engineering works, trains are not stopping at this station today.
items.notes: because of 后接名词短语；engineering works 在交通语境中指施工。

items.zh: 我已经买了票，为什么还需要预约座位？
items.en: I've already bought a ticket, so why do I still need a seat reservation?
answers: I've already bought a ticket, so why do I still need a seat reservation?
I have already bought a ticket, so why do I still need a seat reservation?
items.notes: already 与 still 对照已做的事和仍需做的事；seat reservation 指订座。

items.zh: 如果末班车赶不上了，我们就打车回去。
items.en: If we miss the last bus, we'll take a taxi back.
answers: If we miss the last bus, we'll take a taxi back.
If we miss the last bus, we will take a taxi back.
items.notes: miss a bus 表示没赶上车；条件从句用现在时，主句用 will。

items.zh: 比起最快的路线，我更想选不用爬楼梯的那条。
items.en: I'd prefer the route without stairs to the fastest one.
answers: I'd prefer the route without stairs to the fastest one.
items.notes: prefer A to B 比较偏好；one 代指 route。

items.zh: 过了桥后向左转，邮局就在面包店对面。
items.en: Turn left after crossing the bridge; the post office is opposite the bakery.
answers: Turn left after crossing the bridge; the post office is opposite the bakery.
items.notes: after crossing 表示过桥之后；opposite 可直接接地点名词。

items.zh: 我正在找这条街上有蓝色门的那栋房子。
items.en: I'm looking for the house on this street that has a blue door.
answers: I'm looking for the house on this street that has a blue door.
I am looking for the house on this street that has a blue door.
items.notes: that 从句修饰 house；通过可见特征明确位置。

items.zh: 地图显示我们在河对岸，但我看不到附近有桥。
items.en: The map shows us on the other side of the river, but I can't see a bridge nearby.
answers: The map shows us on the other side of the river, but I can't see a bridge nearby.
The map shows us on the other side of the river, but I cannot see a bridge nearby.
items.notes: on the other side of 表示在另一边；nearby 作副词。

items.zh: 到广场之后，应该走哪个出口去博物馆？
items.en: Once we reach the square, which exit should we take for the museum?
answers: Once we reach the square, which exit should we take for the museum?
items.notes: once 引导时间从句；take an exit 表示走某个出口。

items.zh: 即使导航说只要十分钟，带着孩子走也可能更久。
items.en: Even if the navigation app says ten minutes, walking with children may take longer.
answers: Even if the navigation app says ten minutes, walking with children may take longer.
items.notes: even if 提出让步；walking ... 为动名词主语。

items.zh: 我们是不是已经走过那家药店了？
items.en: Have we already walked past the pharmacy?
answers: Have we already walked past the pharmacy?
items.notes: walk past 表示从旁边经过；already 询问是否比预期更早发生。

items.zh: 我的手机没电了，可以借用电话联系旅馆吗？
items.en: My phone has run out of battery; could I use a phone to contact my hotel?
answers: My phone has run out of battery; could I use a phone to contact my hotel?
items.notes: run out of 表示用尽；contact 为及物动词，后面不加 with。

items.zh: 我把钱包落在出租车上了，里面有我的身份证件。
items.en: I left my wallet in a taxi, and my identity documents are inside it.
answers: I left my wallet in a taxi, and my identity documents are inside it.
items.notes: leave sth somewhere 表示把物品落在某处；清楚说明遗失物及重要内容。

items.zh: 有人能帮忙联系急救服务吗？这里有人需要紧急帮助。
items.en: Can someone contact the emergency services? Someone here needs urgent help.
answers: Can someone contact the emergency services? Someone here needs urgent help.
items.notes: emergency services 指当地紧急救援服务；不预设某个国家的电话号码。

items.zh: 在找到住处之前，我们需要一个安全的地方等候。
items.en: Until we find somewhere to stay, we need a safe place to wait.
answers: Until we find somewhere to stay, we need a safe place to wait.
items.notes: until 引出等待终点；somewhere to stay 中不定式修饰地点。

items.zh: 您能写下报失编号，方便我后续查询吗？
items.en: Could you write down the lost-property reference number so that I can follow up later?
answers: Could you write down the lost-property reference number so that I can follow up later?
items.notes: so that 说明目的；follow up 表示后续跟进。

items.zh: 让我担心的是，我没有随身携带护照复印件。
items.en: What worries me is that I don't have a copy of my passport with me.
answers: What worries me is that I don't have a copy of my passport with me.
What worries me is that I do not have a copy of my passport with me.
items.notes: what 从句作主语；have sth with me 表示随身带着。

items.zh: 如果天气允许，我们打算明天坐船去岛上。
items.en: Weather permitting, we plan to take a boat to the island tomorrow.
answers: Weather permitting, we plan to take a boat to the island tomorrow.
items.notes: weather permitting 是独立主格结构，相当于 if the weather permits。

items.zh: 出发前，我想确认山间步道是否仍然开放。
items.en: Before setting off, I'd like to check whether the mountain trail is still open.
answers: Before setting off, I'd like to check whether the mountain trail is still open.
items.notes: set off 表示出发；whether 引出需要确认的状态。

items.zh: 我们取消了最远的那一站，这样每天就不用赶路了。
items.en: We dropped the most distant stop from our itinerary so that we wouldn't have to rush each day.
answers: We dropped the most distant stop from our itinerary so that we wouldn't have to rush each day.
We dropped the most distant stop from our itinerary so that we would not have to rush each day.
items.notes: drop ... from ... 表示从计划中删去；so that 引出调整目的。

items.zh: 与其一天跑遍所有景点，我们宁愿把时间留给两个最感兴趣的地方。
items.en: Rather than visit every attraction in one day, we'd prefer to spend time at the two places that interest us most.
answers: Rather than visit every attraction in one day, we'd prefer to spend time at the two places that interest us most.
items.notes: rather than 引出被放弃的方案；that 从句修饰 places。

items.zh: 到我们到达游客中心时，导览活动已经结束了。
items.en: By the time we reached the visitor centre, the guided tour had ended.
answers: By the time we reached the visitor centre, the guided tour had ended.
items.notes: by the time 搭配过去完成时，明确两个过去事件的先后。

items.zh: 无论最后选择哪条路线，都请把预计返回时间告诉前台。
items.en: Whichever route you choose in the end, please tell reception when you expect to return.
answers: Whichever route you choose in the end, please tell reception when you expect to return.
items.notes: whichever 引导让步；when 从句使用陈述语序，作 tell 的内容。

items.zh: 我的姓在机票上少了一个字母，需要在哪里更正？
items.en: One letter is missing from my surname on the ticket; where can I correct it?
answers: One letter is missing from my surname on the ticket; where can I correct it?

items.zh: 在线值机已经完成，但我没有收到登机牌。
items.en: I have checked in online, but I have not received a boarding pass.
answers: I have checked in online, but I have not received a boarding pass.
I've checked in online, but I've not received a boarding pass.

items.zh: 我们同行但座位分开，能否安排坐得近一些？
items.en: We are travelling together but seated apart; could we be moved closer to each other?
answers: We are travelling together but seated apart; could we be moved closer to each other?
We're travelling together but seated apart; could we be moved closer to each other?

items.zh: 安检时需要把平板电脑单独拿出来吗？
items.en: Do I need to remove my tablet separately at security?
answers: Do I need to remove my tablet separately at security?

items.zh: 这件行李超过限重多少？
items.en: How much is this bag over the weight limit?
answers: How much is this bag over the weight limit?

items.zh: 我需要步行很远才能转机吗，还是有接驳车？
items.en: Is it a long walk to the connecting flight, or is there a shuttle?
answers: Is it a long walk to the connecting flight, or is there a shuttle?

items.zh: 航班取消通知里有没有说明住宿安排？
items.en: Does the cancellation notice mention accommodation arrangements?
answers: Does the cancellation notice mention accommodation arrangements?

items.zh: 请确认行李标签上的目的地是否正确。
items.en: Please check that the destination on the baggage tag is correct.
answers: Please check that the destination on the baggage tag is correct.

items.zh: 我比预定入住时间早到了，有房间可以提前入住吗？
items.en: I arrived before the scheduled check-in time; is a room available early?
answers: I arrived before the scheduled check-in time; is a room available early?

items.zh: 门卡失效了，我无法进入房间。
items.en: The key card has stopped working, and I cannot get into the room.
answers: The key card has stopped working, and I cannot get into the room.
The key card has stopped working, and I can't get into the room.

items.zh: 这间房的窗户打不开，可以派人看看吗？
items.en: The window in this room will not open; could someone take a look?
answers: The window in this room will not open; could someone take a look?
The window in this room won't open; could someone take a look?
items.notes: will not 可描述物件无法正常工作。

items.zh: 早餐在哪一层，几点结束？
items.en: Which floor is breakfast served on, and when does it finish?
answers: Which floor is breakfast served on, and when does it finish?

items.zh: 预订里包含的早餐适用于所有住客吗？
items.en: Does the breakfast included in the booking cover every guest?
answers: Does the breakfast included in the booking cover every guest?

items.zh: 请在发票上分别列出住宿费和其他费用。
items.en: Please itemise the room charge and other expenses on the invoice.
answers: Please itemise the room charge and other expenses on the invoice.

items.zh: 我需要安静的房间，最好远离电梯。
items.en: I need a quiet room, preferably away from the lift.
answers: I need a quiet room, preferably away from the lift.

items.zh: 如果明早没有热水，请提前告诉我们。
items.en: If hot water will be unavailable tomorrow morning, please let us know in advance.
answers: If hot water will be unavailable tomorrow morning, please let us know in advance.
items.notes: will be unavailable 表示已知的未来安排。

items.zh: 我是在机器上取票，还是去人工窗口？
items.en: Should I collect my ticket from the machine or the staffed counter?
answers: Should I collect my ticket from the machine or the staffed counter?

items.zh: 这趟列车的前半部分和后半部分会去不同的地方吗？
items.en: Will the front and rear sections of this train go to different destinations?
answers: Will the front and rear sections of this train go to different destinations?

items.zh: 电子车票打不开，我可以出示确认邮件吗？
items.en: My electronic ticket will not open; may I show the confirmation email?
answers: My electronic ticket will not open; may I show the confirmation email?
My electronic ticket won't open; may I show the confirmation email?

items.zh: 站台变更后，我们是否还有足够时间上车？
items.en: After the platform change, do we still have enough time to board?
answers: After the platform change, do we still have enough time to board?
items.notes: board 可作动词表示上车。

items.zh: 这张票只能坐指定班次，还是当天都有效？
items.en: Is this ticket valid only for a specific departure or for the whole day?
answers: Is this ticket valid only for a specific departure or for the whole day?

items.zh: 我下错站了，回去需要重新买票吗？
items.en: I got off at the wrong stop; do I need a new ticket to go back?
answers: I got off at the wrong stop; do I need a new ticket to go back?

items.zh: 公共汽车只停靠指定站点，不会在酒店门口停。
items.en: The bus serves designated stops and will not stop outside the hotel.
answers: The bus serves designated stops and will not stop outside the hotel.
The bus serves designated stops and won't stop outside the hotel.

items.zh: 我们带着婴儿车，哪条路线不用上下楼梯？
items.en: We have a pushchair; which route avoids stairs?
answers: We have a pushchair; which route avoids stairs?

items.zh: 租车费用包含第二位驾驶员吗？
items.en: Does the rental price include an additional driver?
answers: Does the rental price include an additional driver?
items.notes: additional driver：额外登记的驾驶员。

items.zh: 取车之前，我想记录车身已有的划痕。
items.en: Before collecting the car, I would like to record the existing scratches.
answers: Before collecting the car, I would like to record the existing scratches.
Before collecting the car, I'd like to record the existing scratches.

items.zh: 还车时油箱需要加满吗？
items.en: Does the fuel tank need to be full when I return the car?
answers: Does the fuel tank need to be full when I return the car?

items.zh: 如果车在路上出故障，应该联系哪个号码？
items.en: Which number should I call if the car breaks down on the road?
answers: Which number should I call if the car breaks down on the road?

items.zh: 这里的停车费是按小时计算，还是全天固定价格？
items.en: Is parking charged by the hour or at a fixed daily rate?
answers: Is parking charged by the hour or at a fixed daily rate?

items.zh: 停车机器不接受我的卡，有其他付款方式吗？
items.en: The parking machine will not accept my card; is there another way to pay?
answers: The parking machine will not accept my card; is there another way to pay?
The parking machine won't accept my card; is there another way to pay?
items.notes: another way to do：另一种方式。

items.zh: 这条路暂时封闭，我们需要按照标志绕行。
items.en: This road is temporarily closed, so we need to follow the diversion signs.
answers: This road is temporarily closed, so we need to follow the diversion signs.

items.zh: 导航让我们驶入小路，但标志显示不允许通行。
items.en: The navigation directs us onto a side road, but the sign says access is prohibited.
answers: The navigation directs us onto a side road, but the sign says access is prohibited.

items.zh: 菜单上的价格是否已经包含服务费？
items.en: Do the menu prices already include a service charge?
answers: Do the menu prices already include a service charge?

items.zh: 我点的饮料还没上，能帮我查看一下吗？
items.en: The drink I ordered has not arrived; could you check on it?
answers: The drink I ordered has not arrived; could you check on it?
The drink I ordered hasn't arrived; could you check on it?

items.zh: 我们只有半个小时，哪些菜能比较快做好？
items.en: We only have half an hour; which dishes can be prepared quickly?
answers: We only have half an hour; which dishes can be prepared quickly?

items.zh: 这道菜本来应该是热的，但送来时已经凉了。
items.en: This dish was meant to be hot, but it arrived cold.
answers: This dish was meant to be hot, but it arrived cold.

items.zh: 我想把剩下的食物打包带走。
items.en: I would like to have the remaining food packed to take away.
answers: I would like to have the remaining food packed to take away.
I'd like to have the remaining food packed to take away.
items.notes: have sth done：请人处理某物。

items.zh: 能否推荐不含乳制品的选项，并确认配料？
items.en: Could you suggest a dairy-free option and confirm the ingredients?
answers: Could you suggest a dairy-free option and confirm the ingredients?

items.zh: 我们已经预付了定金，这笔钱会从账单里扣除吗？
items.en: We have paid a deposit; will it be deducted from the bill?
answers: We have paid a deposit; will it be deducted from the bill?
We've paid a deposit; will it be deducted from the bill?

items.zh: 我想先看看今天的特价菜，再决定点什么。
items.en: I would like to see today's specials before deciding what to order.
answers: I would like to see today's specials before deciding what to order.
I'd like to see today's specials before deciding what to order.

items.zh: 这件商品可以拆开检查，还是必须保持封装？
items.en: May I open this item to inspect it, or must it remain sealed?
answers: May I open this item to inspect it, or must it remain sealed?

items.zh: 我买错了尺寸，但收据还在，能换吗？
items.en: I bought the wrong size but still have the receipt; can I exchange it?
answers: I bought the wrong size but still have the receipt; can I exchange it?

items.zh: 价签上的折扣似乎没有体现在结账金额中。
items.en: The discount on the price tag does not seem to appear in the total.
answers: The discount on the price tag does not seem to appear in the total.
The discount on the price tag doesn't seem to appear in the total.

items.zh: 这个充电器适用于我所在国家的插座吗？
items.en: Is this charger compatible with the sockets in my country?
answers: Is this charger compatible with the sockets in my country?

items.zh: 能否把易碎品包装好，方便带上飞机？
items.en: Could you pack the fragile items securely for air travel?
answers: Could you pack the fragile items securely for air travel?

items.zh: 这张礼品卡必须一次用完吗？
items.en: Does this gift card have to be used in one transaction?
answers: Does this gift card have to be used in one transaction?

items.zh: 我不想订阅会员，只想购买这件商品。
items.en: I only want to buy this item, not sign up for a membership.
answers: I only want to buy this item, not sign up for a membership.

items.zh: 如果商品到货，请通过邮件通知我。
items.en: Please notify me by email when the item is back in stock.
answers: Please notify me by email when the item is back in stock.

items.zh: 这条徒步路线适合第一次来的人吗？
items.en: Is this walking route suitable for a first-time visitor?
answers: Is this walking route suitable for a first-time visitor?

items.zh: 我们需要提前预约露营地，还是到达后登记即可？
items.en: Must we book the campsite ahead, or can we register on arrival?
answers: Must we book the campsite ahead, or can we register on arrival?

items.zh: 游客中心有最新的天气和步道信息吗？
items.en: Does the visitor centre have current weather and trail information?
answers: Does the visitor centre have current weather and trail information?

items.zh: 船票上的登船地点和地图显示的不一样。
items.en: The boarding point on the boat ticket differs from the one on the map.
answers: The boarding point on the boat ticket differs from the one on the map.

items.zh: 我们想参加小团，而不是人数很多的团队。
items.en: We would prefer a small group rather than a large tour party.
answers: We would prefer a small group rather than a large tour party.

items.zh: 这次活动需要自带装备吗？
items.en: Do we need to bring our own equipment for this activity?
answers: Do we need to bring our own equipment for this activity?

items.zh: 导游讲解包含在门票里，但耳机需要另外租。
items.en: The guide's commentary is included in admission, but headsets must be hired separately.
answers: The guide's commentary is included in admission, but headsets must be hired separately.

items.zh: 日落后这里还有公共交通返回市区吗？
items.en: Is there public transport back to the city after sunset?
answers: Is there public transport back to the city after sunset?

items.zh: 我的同伴和我们走散了，最后一次见到他是在售票处。
items.en: My companion got separated from us; we last saw him at the ticket office.
answers: My companion got separated from us; we last saw him at the ticket office.

items.zh: 我需要找到一个工作人员可以提供帮助的地方。
items.en: I need somewhere with staff who can help.
answers: I need somewhere with staff who can help.
items.notes: somewhere with：有某设施或人员的地方。

items.zh: 我没有网络，能否告诉我最近的服务台在哪里？
items.en: I have no internet connection; could you tell me where the nearest service desk is?
answers: I have no internet connection; could you tell me where the nearest service desk is?
items.notes: 间接疑问句使用陈述语序。

items.zh: 这个地址是我现在所在的位置，不是我的住宿地址。
items.en: This address is my current location, not where I am staying.
answers: This address is my current location, not where I am staying.
This address is my current location, not where I'm staying.

items.zh: 我能借纸和笔，把重要号码记下来吗？
items.en: Could I borrow a pen and some paper to note down an important number?
answers: Could I borrow a pen and some paper to note down an important number?

items.zh: 失物描述中需要包括颜色、品牌和里面的物品吗？
items.en: Should the lost-item description include its colour, brand and contents?
answers: Should the lost-item description include its colour, brand and contents?

items.zh: 我们已经联系了住宿方，他们知道我们会晚到。
items.en: We have contacted our accommodation provider, and they know we will arrive late.
answers: We have contacted our accommodation provider, and they know we will arrive late.
We've contacted our accommodation provider, and they know we'll arrive late.

items.zh: 如果无法今晚离开，请告诉我们哪里可以得到进一步协助。
items.en: If we cannot leave tonight, please tell us where further assistance is available.
answers: If we cannot leave tonight, please tell us where further assistance is available.
If we can't leave tonight, please tell us where further assistance is available.
